            selected_context = (

            before = len(prefix)
            changed = (
                CONTEXT_MODE == "suffix_augmentation"
                and selected_context
                and before > RECENT_CONTEXT_LENGTH
            )
            if changed:
                # Preserve the original absolute columns and the final MASK.
                # encode_sequence blocks these PAD keys in every encoder layer.
                seq[: maxlen - 1 - RECENT_CONTEXT_LENGTH] = 0
            stats["endpoint_examples"] += 1
            stats["context_selected"] += int(selected_context)
            stats["context_changed"] += int(changed)
            stats["context_tokens_before"] += before
            stats["context_tokens_after"] += (
                RECENT_CONTEXT_LENGTH if changed else before
            )
